note: General Ozarks campground near Salem, the Current River and Montauk State Park that caters to trail riders as well as RVers (horse stalls, wash station and trails), with cabins and rental travel trailers. VisitMO lists 60+ water/electric sites and 24 full hookups; the operator gives no count. --Claude
summary: Operator site: confirmed $30-35 RV rates and water/sewer hookups; added showers/store, phone/email booking with first-night deposit and no-refund terms; note cleaned. Passes private gates; not waterfront stands.
flags: Private gates: rate $30 (W/E) - $35 (full) from the operator's price list, which carries no date (Wix page read live 2026-11-07; the same figures were read 2026-10-16). No gateway within 40 km (Branson 167 km); family has not stayed. Presence: working site with phone 573-548-3322; Google Maps 4.9 (269 reviews). RV Life 5 stars (2 reviews) and its index now tags it price_level 3 (avg_rate $44), against the stored rating's tier 2 - the posted rates are $30-35.
Horse-friendly but not a horse camp: the price list sells 'RV's & Horse Trailer Sites' and tent sites to all campers; horses are an add-on. Not a criteria problem.
Electric amperage is not stated on any operator page; hookups.electric left unset.

Pin 37.4605,-91.6328 is at the office/store by Hwy YY (Google 37.46065,-91.63250); the sites are spread around it within ~150 m. No move. No water near the sites (a small pond only); 'not waterfront' stands.
